description: Derive your hourly freelance rate from your income goal, billable hours and a buffer for taxes and downtime.

faqs.a: Your target income is marked up by the buffer percentage, then divided by total billable hours per year (billable hours/week × working weeks/year). The buffer is meant to cover taxes, unpaid admin time, sick days and client gaps.
faqs.q: How is the hourly rate calculated?

faqs.a: The buffer is a safety margin added on top of your target income. 25–40% is a common starting point to cover income tax and non-billable time.
faqs.q: What should I use for the buffer %?

faqs.a: Yes — the 8-hour day rate and weekly rate are just the hourly rate multiplied out, so they stay consistent.
faqs.q: Does it give day and week rates too?

howto: Enter your target annual take-home income.
Enter your billable hours per week and working weeks per year.
Add a buffer % for taxes and non-billable time.
Read your hourly, 8-hour day and weekly rates.
title: Freelance Rate Calculator
